'''January 2000 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 29 January 2000. [[Michael Dalton]] won it. It is known from Michael Dalton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d210">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-30-1-29-00-cedar-grove-njd210/ 1-29-00-cedar-grove-nj], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 30 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-30-1-29-00-cedar-grove-njd210/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Dalton]]
